name: Whiteman AFB
description: Home of the 509th Bomb Wing. Whiteman AFB is the only operational B-2 Spirit stealth bomber base, providing global strike capability.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Spirit Gate (West / Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access with Visitor Control Center. Main entry point for visitors and base personnel.

gates.name: Arnold Gate (North / Knob Noster Gate)
gates.notes: North side access. Closed weekends and holidays.

gates.name: LeMay Gate (South / Commercial Gate)
gates.notes: Commercial and contractor access only. Closed weekends and holidays.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Spirit Gate)
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Walk-ins processed in order of arrival. Foreign national visits require 14-day advance processing.

resources.name: Ozark Inn Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting the 509th Bomb Wing with full meal service and 24/7 grab-and-go options.
resources.hours: See posted meal hours; grab-and-go available 24/7

resources.name: Whiteman Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: RG Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Sports & Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, aquatics, and 24/7 access for registered card holders.
resources.hours: Mon-Thu 0500-2200; Fri 0500-2000; Sat-Sun 1000-1700; 24/7 for registered users

resources.name: Whiteman Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1615; closed last Wednesday of month for training

resources.name: 509th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Whiteman Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: Stars and Strikes Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling alley with lanes and snack bar.

resources.name: 509th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Whiteman Inn (660-687-1844) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (660-687-5662) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 509 FSS, M&FRC, and official Whiteman sites for in-processing and B-2 mission support.
